name: boundary-partial-wpm
description: Boundary (palette tile 1552,143) painted at size 1 (one corner: every tile it touches is partly painted); the pathing map and the corner flags each editor saves. The click lands at world tile 32.0,29.66: the editor's Boundary brush is centred on the corner below and left of the pointer (the lower-left corner of the tile under it: 32,29), not the nearest corner as its other brushes (measured 2026-11-14, branch boundary-we: 16 clicks at fractions 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8 of a tile in x and y all flagged the floor corner). Its pathing map blocks the tile whose lower-left corner is painted, the 16 cells 128-131 x 116-119, at 0xce (the map margin's byte)

name: boundary-full-wpm
description: Boundary painted at size 3 (13 corners: four tiles fully painted, more partly); the pathing map and the corner flags each editor saves. The editor's 13 corners are the circle of radius 2 round corner 32,29 (the lower-left corner of the tile under the pointer; sizes 2 and 5 measured the same way, 5 and 49 corners round the floor corner, 2026-11-14) and its pathing map blocks 13 tiles, one per painted corner, 208 cells at 0xce: a tile is blocked when its lower-left corner is painted, whether its other three are or not

name: boundary-flags-wpm
description: Boundary with other flags on the blank map (2026-11-14, branch boundary-we): size 3 at tile 28.4,30.4 (562,469) then Remove Boundary (1552,175) size 1 there: the floor corner 28,30 comes off and its tile is 0x40 again; Blight (1552,111) size 3 at 36.4,31.4 (970,428) then Boundary size 1 there (corner 36,31); then Shallow water (1473,310) picked while Boundary is still the chosen tile, size 2, one click at 36.3,26.3 (996,664): the editor applies both, water round the nearest corner 36,26 and Boundary round the floor corner, the same 5 corners (Studio: Boundary then Shallow, both size 2, at that point). A tile whose lower-left corner is painted is 0xce whatever else it is: a cliff (0xca without), or under water (0x08 without: a fully watered tile measured so on an earlier round); blighted it keeps the blight bit, 0xee (tile 36,31). The Boundary flags (18 corners) and the water match; DIFFERS in war3map.w3e only by the editor's Blight brush, not Boundary: it also turns 36 corners round the size-3 blight (tiles 33-40 x 28-35, an irregular set) to the map's second ground tile, Ldro, where Studio's Blight sets only the flag
